app_name: Habit Eazy - Habit & To Do Pal
text: This app is easy to use, not complicated, not cluttered, and has a clean UI. Adding habits is easy. Habit can be customized with an icon and a theme color. There is also capability to add tasks. You can add sub-tasks, attach image, assign priority, and organize tasks into lists. Habits completion and streak can be tracked on a statistics dashboard. There is also a home screen "journey" dashboard that shows a snapshot of the habits for quick status update.
